description: This file defines the Analytics class, which is a plugin for handling JSONRPC communication channels within the WPEFramework. It declares the class, its inheritance, interface mappings, and key methods related to initialization, deinitialization, and notification handling.

classes.name: Analytics
classes.description: A plugin class that handles JSONRPC communication, inherits from PluginHost::IPlugin and PluginHost::JSONRPC, manages analytics interactions, and provides notification capabilities.

methods.description: Constructor for the Analytics plugin class.
